description: Vulnerability in the Oracle iSupplier Portal product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Internal Operations).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle iSupplier Portal.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle iSupplier Portal accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.5 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).
